_note: Hand-compiled from public post-mortems. Severities are approximate peak losses at the failing component and are used to sanity-check severity priors and to replay incidents. Verify figures before external use.

incidents.name: USDC depeg after SVB failure
incidents.summary: Circle disclosed $3.3B of reserves stuck at Silicon Valley Bank. USDC traded as low as ~$0.88 before recovering once US deposits were backstopped.

incidents.name: UST / LUNA collapse
incidents.summary: Algorithmic stablecoin UST lost its peg and went to near zero within a week, wiping out ~$40B.

incidents.name: Stream Finance xUSD collapse
incidents.summary: Stream disclosed ~$93M lost by an external fund manager; xUSD fell far below $1 and lending markets that accepted it with fixed-rate oracles were left with bad debt.

incidents.name: stETH discount during 3AC / Celsius
incidents.summary: Forced sellers pushed stETH to ~0.93 ETH on Curve before withdrawals were enabled.

incidents.name: Mango Markets oracle manipulation
incidents.summary: Attacker pumped MNGO spot price, borrowed against the inflated collateral and drained ~$114M.

incidents.name: Inverse Finance oracle manipulation
incidents.summary: A TWAP oracle on a thin pool was pushed up to borrow ~$15.6M against INV.

incidents.name: Morpho PAXG/USDC misconfigured oracle
incidents.summary: A wrongly scaled oracle on a permissionless Morpho market let an attacker borrow ~$230k against a tiny amount of PAXG. Isolation kept the loss to that one market.

incidents.name: Wormhole bridge unbacked mint
incidents.summary: 120k wETH minted on Solana with nothing locked (~$325M). Jump Crypto recapitalised the bridge, so holders were made whole - severity at the holder was ~0 only because of the bailout.

incidents.name: Nomad bridge drain
incidents.summary: A faulty upgrade let anyone replay messages; ~$190M drained and Nomad-bridged tokens lost most of their value.

incidents.name: Multichain collapse
incidents.summary: Keys controlled by the CEO became inaccessible after his arrest; bridged assets on Fantom and others depegged heavily.

incidents.name: Ankr aBNBc infinite mint
incidents.summary: A compromised deployer key minted 10 trillion aBNBc; price went to ~0 and the attacker borrowed real assets on Helio.

incidents.name: Paxos mints $300T of PYUSD by mistake
incidents.summary: A single Paxos-controlled key with unrestricted mint rights created 300 trillion unbacked PYUSD during an internal transfer. Paxos burned it 22 minutes later and Aave froze PYUSD markets meanwhile; holders lost nothing.

incidents.name: Euler Finance exploit
incidents.summary: A donation-function bug drained ~$197M from Euler. Funds were later returned, but lenders were frozen for weeks.

incidents.name: Solana outage
incidents.summary: One of several Solana halts in 2021-2022; no transactions could be sent, liquidations stopped.

incidents.name: Base sequencer outage
incidents.summary: Base stopped producing blocks for about 45 minutes.

incidents.name: USDe dislocation on Binance
incidents.summary: During the October 10 liquidation cascade USDe printed ~$0.65 on Binance's order book while on-chain pools held near $1 - a venue-specific oracle failure.
